Unfortunately there's nothing much interesting going on here, so I decided I would come back to the palace. I ótried to pay Gorath an unexpected visit last night, but discovered that the guards had been doubled with orders that no one could see him. Finally, I came down here and talked to Limm who told me you had been down here earlier this morning. At that point, I realized Arutha meant to slip Gorath out of Krondor for some reason.�

All right then squire, you can come along, but these are the ground rules. One, I am in charge and you do whatever I say without question.
